headline: Obama order sets goals for processing visas and foreign visitors and creates a task force on travel and competitiveness.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets goals for how the federal government handles visa applications and processes foreign visitors coming to the United States. It also creates a Task Force on Travel and Competitiveness. No summary was provided, so the specific goals, deadlines, and task force duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Foreign travelers applying for US visas
who_it_affects.how: The order sets goals for how visa applications and visitor processing are handled.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle visas and foreign visitors
who_it_affects.how: These agencies are given processing goals to work toward.
The new task force focuses on travel and competitiveness, which relates to their industry.
